mapper.select: SELECT company_code, cust_code, cust_name, ceo_name, bno, btype, bitem, phone, fax_no, cust_email, zonecode, address, address_detail, cust_type, dept, user_name, use_status, created_by, create_date, updated_by, update_date FROM tb_cust_master WHERE cust_code = #{custCode}
